0022600163.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-5, 13th in the East, on a four-game losing streak) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (6-1, 1st in the East, winners of three straight), who are 3-1 at home while the Bulls are 1-3 on the road. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring) and Dailyn Swain (day-to-day, back soreness, game-time decision), while Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), Joel Embiid (out, foot), and LeBron James (out, back). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Bulls won the season series 2-1, though the most recent meeting, on March 25, 2026 in Philadelphia, ended with the Bulls losing 157-137.
